evidence.why: Complete guarded counter and equality ladder.

facts.rationale: Replaces an unconditional threshold narrative with actual gates, precedence, failure paths and lifetime preconditions.
facts.value: Only Link-family calls increment mv.ca.specials.grav. Equality with f32(x84) creates and stores an article and installs three callbacks; failure calls ft_8008A2BC and returns true. Otherwise later events require counter > f32(x84) and <= f32(x90). Within that interval the ordered equality ladder tests x88, x8C, then x90. x88 performs the horizontal obstruction test and either removes/exits/returns true or submits horizontal velocity and sound; x8C selects the next item phase and sound; x90 requests removal. Ordinary paths return false. Coincident thresholds obey branch priority; skipped or out-of-range thresholds are not recovered. The interval assumes a valid article even between events; NaN counters select no event.

facts.rationale: Corrects offset interpretation using the actual vector consumer, without assigning numeric item states unsupported gameplay names.
facts.value: Reads Link-family fighter attributes, kind, facing direction and right-thumb joint; increments mv.co.catch.x0; stores the constructor result in u.lk.xC and installs accessory2/death1/accessory3 callbacks on success. At x98 it submits (TetherAttributes.pos_x_0 * facing_dir,0,0) to it_802A78B8; the callee copies this vector to ItemLink.vel, so it is a velocity rather than an offset. Later calls select an item phase and request removal, with character-selected sound IDs. Creation failure calls ft_8008A2BC and returns true; the CatchDash caller short-circuits on true.

facts.rationale: Records precise boundary and branch behavior, avoiding unproved firing/return sound labels.
facts.value: Only FTKIND_LINK and FTKIND_CLINK advance mv.co.catch.x0 by one. Equality with f32(x94) creates the article and installs callbacks, or calls ft_8008A2BC and returns true on failure. Otherwise processing requires counter > f32(x94) and <= f32(xA0), with ordered equality checks x98, x9C, xA0 for velocity submission, next-phase command, and removal respectively. Earlier equal thresholds win and thresholds outside the interval cannot execute. There is no local obstruction test. All other paths return false. The active interval dereferences a presumed live article even on nonevent frames; NaN counters select no event.
